purpose: Candidate-independent Tier-1 raw BID/ASK acquisition and generic boundary quote-dynamics evidence for later Discovery execution-cost calibration. This plan does not define candidate fills, does not replace MARKET_PROXY timing, and does not inspect candidate signals/returns/PnL.

reference_calendar.raw_capture_rule: RAW REQUESTS REMAIN ALL WEEKDAY 09:30-16:00 ET ENVELOPES, INCLUDING HOLIDAYS/EARLY-CLOSE TAILS; NO RETURNED QUOTE IS REMOVED OR FABRICATED

acquisition_domain.holidays: RAW ENVELOPE STILL REQUESTED; EMPTY BROKER RESPONSE IS PRESERVED
acquisition_domain.early_closes: RAW REGULAR ENVELOPE STILL REQUESTED; DERIVED OFFICIAL CASH-SESSION BOUNDARIES STOP AT OFFICIAL EARLY CLOSE

pagination_policy.rule: When hasMore=true, re-request ending at the oldest decoded timestamp to retain boundary-ms evidence. If oldest timestamp fails to move on the next page, decrement by 1ms to guarantee progress and record the fallback.

generic_boundary_evidence.boundaries: EVERY OFFICIAL M15 CASH-SESSION BOUNDARY FROM 09:30 THROUGH OFFICIAL SESSION CLOSE INCLUSIVE

CAUSAL_STATE_AT_BOUNDARY.definition: Latest causally observed BID at or before boundary plus latest causally observed ASK at or before boundary, independently. A pre-boundary side remains current until an observed update changes that side.

FIRST_POST_BOUNDARY_BID_EVENT.definition: First observed BID event at or after the generic boundary within the preserved raw acquisition tape.

FIRST_POST_BOUNDARY_ASK_EVENT.definition: First observed ASK event at or after the generic boundary within the preserved raw acquisition tape.

FIRST_POST_BOUNDARY_ANY_QUOTE_EVENT.definition: Earliest observed BID and/or ASK event timestamp at or after the generic boundary.

BOTH_SIDES_REFRESHED_AFTER_BOUNDARY.definition: First causal two-sided state for which BID and ASK have each independently refreshed at or after boundary.

market_proxy_separation.rule: Candidate MARKET_PROXY price/timing and spread/slippage/delay evidence remain conceptually separate. Derived quote events do not silently replace candidate OHLC entry or exit proxies.

numeric_execution_rule_pre_capture.reason: Freeze the candidate-independent calibration process before capture; choose no numeric economic execution rule until generic quote dynamics are observed without candidate signals/returns/PnL.

resume_contract_binding.mismatch_policy: ARCHIVE INCOMPATIBLE WORK DIRECTORY AND START EMPTY; NEVER SILENTLY REUSE CHUNKS
